statement: For smooth compact Kähler manifolds, specialness in the definition of Section 1 is bimeromorphically invariant and is preserved by connected finite étale covers. The Albanese morphism of a special manifold is surjective with connected fibres. Moreover, if a line bundle L has a nonzero morphism to Ωp X, then κ(X, L) ≤ p.
